author: roflcakesss
quote: Performance is horrendous, the male character is basically a woman and is sleeping with another man at the beginning of the game, it has no humor, it makes you simulate being the boyfriend of a super annoying female, everything about this game is not good. Bugs everywhere, collision with models everywhere, it is beyond obvious this was written by someone who was not a fan of the original series. You can't even shoot specific NPCs.... this game is not grand theft auto. This is a game designed by a bunch of HR directors. I hate everything about it to its core.
